language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the wooden spoon at frames 73–79 (wrist_image), lifts and transports it toward the open drawer at frames 86–120 (left_ego_image), and releases it into the drawer at frames 146–151 (wrist_image and image). The spoon remains visibly inside the drawer at frames 152–180 (image), while the empty gripper withdraws. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
